nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Frontend POSTs multipart/form-data: resume (PDF file), locations (JSON string), roles (JSON string), salaryMin, salaryMax.

nodes.name: Parse PDF Text
nodes.notes: Calls Firebase extractResume to convert PDF bytes → plain text. Set FIREBASE_EXTRACT_URL in N8N Settings → Variables.

parameters.jsCode:
const { resumeText, locations, roles, salaryMin, salaryMax } = $input.first().json;

const userRoles = (roles || []).join(', ') || 'not specified';
const userLocs  = (locations || []).join(', ') || 'any';

const prompt =
  `You are a career analyst. Read this resume carefully and extract a precise job-search profile.

` +
  `=== RESUME ===
${resumeText.substring(0, 5000)}
=== END ===

` +
  `=== PREFERENCES ===
Desired roles: ${userRoles}
Locations: ${userLocs}
Salary: ₹${salaryMin}L–₹${salaryMax}L

` +
  `Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown):
` +
  `{
` +
  `  "currentTitle": "most recent job title from resume",
` +
  `  "skills": ["up to 10 specific technical skills/tools found in resume"],
` +
  `  "yearsExperience": <integer total years>,
` +
  `  "seniority": "fresher|junior|mid|senior|lead|principal",
` +
  `  "domain": "specific domain: frontend engineering / backend / data science / product management / devops / mobile / design / marketing",
` +
  `  "industries": ["industries worked in e.g. fintech, ecommerce, saas"],
` +
  `  "searchKeywords": ["5 seniority-matched job titles to search — e.g. Senior React Developer not just Developer"],
` +
  `  "seniorityKeywords": ["seniority level words e.g. Senior, Lead, Staff"],
` +
  `  "avoidKeywords": ["junior, fresher, intern, trainee, entry-level — only if yearsExperience > 3"],
` +
  `  "summary": "one sentence: role, years of exp, top 2-3 skills"
` +
  `}

` +
  `RULES: skills must be real tools from the resume. searchKeywords must match seniority level.`;

return [{ json: { prompt, locations, roles, salaryMin, salaryMax } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a resume analyzer. Return ONLY valid JSON.' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.prompt } ] }) }}

nodes.name: OpenAI: Analyze Resume
nodes.notes: Set OPENAI_KEY in N8N Settings → Variables.
